summary: Practise revenue controls, reconciliations, exception handling, and reporting workflows. Explore the course and plan your team’s training.
lede: Public revenue administration training helps operations, finance and audit teams trace revenue from assessment through collection, accounting and reporting. Participants map control owners, test transaction controls, reconcile assessment and receipt records, classify exceptions, and check digital data quality using TADAT, COSO, IPSAS and PEFA concepts. They also define revenue performance measures and develop practical control, reconciliation and reporting outputs for their agency’s processes.
audienceIntro: Public revenue administration training is designed for professionals responsible for revenue controls, transactions, reconciliation, audit, and operational reporting.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to public finance, revenue administration, tax administration, accounting, or audit workflows is expected. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful for working through reconciliation examples. No coding or programming is required.
